9988-amarilly-of-clothes-line-alley.title: Amarilly Of Clothes Line Alley
9988-amarilly-of-clothes-line-alley.creator: Unknown
9988-amarilly-of-clothes-line-alley.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The rehearsal had been inspiring and awakening, but this, "the real thing," as Amarilly appraised it, bore her into a land of enchantment. She was blind and deaf to everything except the scenes enacted on the stage. Only once was her passionate attention distracted, and that was when Pete in passing gave her an emphatic nudge and a friendly grin as he munificently bestowed upon her a package of gum. This she instantly pocketed "fer the chillern."

arxiv-2107-01645.title: Analytical Stellar Models of Neutron Stars in Teleparallel Gravity
arxiv-2107-01645.creator: Jay Solanki, Rohan Joshi, Malay Garg
arxiv-2107-01645.description: Abstract In this paper, we developed three analytical models and obtained a new class of solutions describing compact stellar structures using the theory of teleparallel gravity. We consider the general anisotropic nature of stellar configurations and solve teleparallel gravity equations.

arxiv-2107-03157.title: Semilinear Transformations in Coding Theory: A New Technique in Code-Based Cryptography
arxiv-2107-03157.creator: Wenshuo Guo, Fang-Wei FuChern Institute of Mathematics and LPMC, Nankai University, Tianjin 300071, China ws_guo@mail.nankai.edu.cn, fwfu@nankai.edu.cn
arxiv-2107-03157.description: Abstract This paper presents a new technique for disturbing the algebraic structure of linear codes in code-based cryptography. This is a new attempt to exploit Gabidulin codes in the McEliece setting and almost all the previous cryptosystems of this type have been completely or partially broken.

arxiv-2202-07803.title: An Exploration of Higher Order Flavor Sum Rules
arxiv-2202-07803.creator: Saquib Hassan
arxiv-2202-07803.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Saquib Hassan. We explore the idea of higher-order flavor sum rules, i.e. sum rules that hold to higher orders in the flavor symmetry-breaking parameters. In particular, we consider isospin sum rules based on B → n ​ π B\to n\pi decays, and U-spin sum rules based on B d B_{d} and B s B_{s} decays to n n charged pions and/or kaons.

arxiv-2205-01811.title: Assessing Dataset Bias in Computer Vision
arxiv-2205-01811.creator: Athiya Deviyani
arxiv-2205-01811.description: Abstract A biased dataset is a dataset that generally has attributes with an uneven class distribution. These biases have the tendency to propagate to the models that train on them, often leading to a poor performance in the minority class.

arxiv-2205-09576.title: Discovering Dynamic Functional Brain Networks via Spatial and Channel-wise Attention
arxiv-2205-09576.creator: Yiheng Liu, Enjie Ge, Mengshen He, Zhengliang Liu, Shijie Zhao, Xintao Hu, Dajiang Zhu, Tianming Liu, Bao Ge
arxiv-2205-09576.description: Abstract Using deep learning models to recognize functional brain networks (FBNs) in functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has been attracting increasing interest recently. However, most existing work focuses on detecting static FBNs from entire fMRI signals, such as correlation-based functional connectivity.

arxiv-2205-11151.title: Split personalities in Bayesian Neural Networks: the case for full marginalisation
arxiv-2205-11151.creator: David Yallup, Will Handley, Mike Hobson, Anthony Lasenby, Pablo Lemos
arxiv-2205-11151.description: Abstract The true posterior distribution of a Bayesian neural network is massively multimodal. Whilst most of these modes are functionally equivalent, we demonstrate that there remains a level of real multimodality that manifests in even the simplest neural network setups.

arxiv-2210-09044.title: Hyper-differential sensitivity analysis with respect to model discrepancy: optimal solution updating Journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
arxiv-2210-09044.creator: Joseph Hart, Bart van Bloemen Waanders
arxiv-2210-09044.description: Abstract A common goal throughout science and engineering is to solve optimization problems constrained by computational models. However, in many cases a high-fidelity numerical emulation of systems cannot be optimized due to code complexity and computational costs which prohibit the use of intrusive and many query algorithms. Rather, lower-fidelity models are constructed to enable intrusive algorithms for large-scale optimization.

arxiv-2211-09878.title: Reducing Hallucinations in Neural Machine Translation with Feature Attribution
arxiv-2211-09878.creator: Joël Tang, Marina Fomicheva, Lucia Specia
arxiv-2211-09878.description: Abstract Neural conditional language generation models achieve the state-of-the-art in Neural Machine Translation (NMT) but are highly dependent on the quality of parallel training dataset. When trained on low-quality datasets, these models are prone to various error types, including hallucinations , i.e. outputs that are fluent, but unrelated to the source sentences.

arxiv-2303-02185.title: Algebraic Lyapunov Functions for Homogeneous Dynamic Systems
arxiv-2303-02185.creator: Hassan Abdelraouf, Eric Feron, Jeff Shamma
arxiv-2303-02185.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hassan Abdelraouf, Eric Feron, Jeff Shamma. A method for constructing homogeneous Lyapunov functions of degree 1 from polynomial invariant sets is presented for linear time varying systems, homogeneous dynamic systems and the class of nonlinear systems that can be represented as such. The method allows the development of Lyapunov functions that are not necessarily symmetric about the origin, unlike the polynomial, homogeneous Lyapunov functions discussed in the prior literature. The work is illustrated by very simple examples.

arxiv-2308-15748.title: Form factor of local operators in the generalized algebraic Bethe ansatz
arxiv-2308-15748.description: Abstract We consider an X ​ Y ​ Z XYZ spin chain within the framework of the generalized algebraic Bethe ansatz. We study form factors of local operators corresponding to the singlet states in the limit of free fermions. We obtain explicit representations for these form factors. G. Kulkarni 1 1 1 giridhar.kulkarni@ens-lyon.

arxiv-2410-24177.title: DC-Spin: A Speaker-invariant Speech Tokenizer for Spoken Language Models
arxiv-2410-24177.creator: Heng-Jui Chang, Hongyu Gong, Changhan Wang, James Glass, Yu-An Chung
arxiv-2410-24177.description: Abstract Spoken language models (SLMs) have gained increasing attention with advancements in text-based, decoder-only language models. SLMs process text and speech, enabling simultaneous speech understanding and generation. This paper presents Double-Codebook Speaker-invariant Clustering (DC-Spin), which aims to improve speech tokenization by bridging audio signals and SLM tokens.

pmc-10539513.title: The characteristics and influencing factors of spatial network of city-based innovation correlation in China: from the perspective of high tech zones
pmc-10539513.creator: Hong Zhang, Lili Jiang, Jia Zhou, Nanchen Chu, Fengjiao Li
pmc-10539513.description: In the context of “space of flows”, city-based innovation correlation in driving economic growth is no longer limited to the traditional hierarchical structure. It is of great significance to explore Chinese cities innovation association network from the perspective of high-tech zones which gather a large number of innovation resources.

pmc-11421662.title: Death-associated protein kinase 3 modulates migration and invasion of triple-negative breast cancer cells
pmc-11421662.creator: Junkai Wang, Anh M Tran-Huynh, Beom-Jun Kim, Doug W Chan, Matthew V Holt, Diana Fandino, Xin Yu, Xiaoli Qi, Jin Wang, Weijie Zhang, Yi-Hsuan Wu, Meenakshi Anurag, Xiang H F Zhang, Bing Zhang, Chonghui Cheng, Charles E Foulds, Matthew J Ellis
pmc-11421662.description: Sixteen patient-derived xenografts (PDXs) were analyzed using a mass spectrometry (MS)-based kinase inhibitor pull-down assay (KIPA), leading to the observation that death-associated protein kinase 3 (DAPK3) is significantly and specifically overexpressed in the triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) models. Validation studies confirmed enrichment of DAPK3 protein, in both TNBC cell lines and tumors, independent of mRNA levels.

pmc-11609091.title: Cultural roots of the myopia boom in Confucian Asia and their implications
pmc-11609091.creator: Fabian Yii
pmc-11609091.description: Current evidence implicates educational pressures and reduced outdoor time as major causes of myopia. This paper examines the ongoing battle against the myopia epidemic in East Asia, including its cultural offshoots such as Singapore, where over 80% of young adults are myopic.

pmc-11638631.title: Culturing stool specimens has no added value in diagnosing pulmonary tuberculosis
pmc-11638631.creator: Dorte Bek Folkvardsen, Victor Naestholt Dahl, Christian Wejse, Erik Svensson, Troels Lillebaek
pmc-11638631.description: Highlights•Evaluates the benefits of stool testing for diagnosing pulmonary tuberculosis (TB).•Analyzes two years of nationwide data from a low-incidence, resource-rich country.•Findings reveal no additional diagnostic value of stool testing.•Suggests stool testing only, could lead to missed TB diagnoses in similar settings.•Advocates for tailored diagnostic strategies based on healthcare context.

pmc-12409546.title: Leveraging Nanotechnology for Safer Herbicide Use: Insights from Maize Tolerance to Nanoencapsulated Atrazine
pmc-12409546.creator: Bruno Teixeira de Sousa, Bruno Henrique Bortotto da Silva, Euler Augusto Inêz, Anderson Do Espírito Santo Pereira, Jhones Luis Oliveira, Leonardo Fernandes Fraceto, Giliardi Dalazen, Halley Caixeta Oliveira
pmc-12409546.description: Previous work has shown that nanoencapsulation of atrazine enhances the herbicidal action of this active ingredient. This increased activity is expected to control weeds and not compromise the tolerance of maize plants to the herbicide. This study aimed to evaluate the tolerance of maize plants to atrazine in postemergence application with different nanoformulations.

pmc-12573427.title: Abortion patients’ perspectives on enhancing a telemedicine model of post-abortion contraception: a qualitative study
pmc-12573427.creator: Nicola Boydell, Sophie Buijsen, John Joseph Reynolds-Wright, Sharon T Cameron, Jeni Harden
pmc-12573427.description: ABSTRACTBackgroundAccess to post-abortion contraception (PAC) is critical for reducing unintended pregnancies and supporting reproductive decision-making. Patients often face challenges in identifying, accessing and initiating their preferred contraceptive methods post-abortion. This may be particularly so with telemedicine models of care with absence of in-person appointments, and reduced opportunities to provide some contraceptive methods.

pmc-12595373.title: Implementation and evaluation of infection prevention and control training in sub-Saharan Africa
pmc-12595373.creator: D. Odada, J. Ndai, R. Thuku, R. Adam
pmc-12595373.description: SummaryHealthcare-associated infections remain a global concern, exacerbated by limited competent infection prevention and control personnel in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). This study evaluated infection prevention and control training using Kirkpatrick's model to determine its effectiveness in enhancing competence in infection preventionists in Kenya.

pmc-12618836.title: Risk Factors for Shoulder Pain, Injury, and Dysfunction in Volleyball Athletes: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-12618836.creator: Daniel Carvalho de Toledo, Pedro Henrique Crema Duarte, Nayanne de Lima Malta, Rafael Almeida Maciel, Jorge Henrique Assunção, Júlio César Carvalho Nardelli, Mauro Emilio Conforto Gracitelli, Eduardo Angeli Malavolta
pmc-12618836.description: Background:Risk factors for injury to the thrower's shoulder remain a controversial topic.Purpose:To prospectively investigate the relationship between risk factors and the outcomes of pain, injury, and dysfunction in the dominant shoulder of volleyball athletes.Study Design:Cohort study; Level of evidence 2.Methods:Professional and masters-level athletes were followed for 8 months. All participants underwent physical examination, goniometry, dynamometry, and ultrasound.

pmc-12742494.title: Hip arthroscopy for magnetic resonance imaging–verified subspine impingement syndrome: 3-year minimum outcomes study
pmc-12742494.creator: Berkcan Akpinar, Edward S. Mojica, Ajay Kanakamedala, Mohammad Samim, Thomas Youm
pmc-12742494.description: Purpose:To determine the clinical outcomes of hip arthroscopy for anterior inferior iliac spine subspine impingement (SSI).Level of Evidence:Case Series; level IV.Methods:Patients who underwent unilateral, primary hip arthroscopy for SSI from February 2015 to December 2017 with minimum 3-year follow-up data were identified (SSI). Analysis of variance, Kaplan-Meier analysis, and regression modeling were used to analyze outcomes.

pmc-13036967.title: Emergency department preparedness and hospital disaster planning: lessons from disasters
pmc-13036967.creator: Mehmet Murat Oktay, Bektaş Sarı, Kazım Ersin Altınsoy, İlker Akbaş, Erdal Yavuz, Gül Özlem Yıldırım
pmc-13036967.description: BackgroundEarthquakes significantly affect public health, causing mass casualties and increased mortality risks. They can damage healthcare facilities and disrupt essential services like information, energy, and water supplies. This study aims to explore the experiences of emergency medicine specialists and healthcare personnel involved in earthquake response efforts to improve Hospital Disaster and Emergency Plans (HAPs).

pmc-13069509.title: Treating alcohol use disorder: recent advances in pharmacology and genomics
pmc-13069509.creator: eBioMedicine
pmc-13069509.description: tion and supportive treatment strategies. AUD is underdiagnosed and undertreated. Despite Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved medications being available in addition to non-pharmacological management, as little as 1.6% of patients with AUD in the USA are estimated to receive pharmacotherapy as part of their treatment.

pmc-13095865.title: Oncological Outcomes Following Different TACE‐Based Conversion Therapies for Intermediate‐Advanced Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-13095865.creator: Hongwei Xu, Yani Liu, Haili Zhang, Haojun Wu, Bo Li, Kefei Chen, Yonggang Wei
pmc-13095865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundTranscatheter arterial chemoembolization (TACE) is widely used for intermediate‐advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The efficacy and safety of TACE combined with systemic treatments as conversion therapy for HCC remain to be explored.MethodsPatients with intermediate‐advanced HCC were divided as following groups based on therapy: (1) TACE; (2) TACE combined with tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TACE+TKI); (3) TACE+TKI and immune checkpoint inhibitors (TACE+TKI+ICI); and (4) TACE combined with Bevacizumab and ICI.

pmc-13279890.title: Meta-EEGs: A structured approach for processing high-volume EEG data
pmc-13279890.creator: Palak Handa, Manya Joshi, Esha Gupta, Ramona Woitek
pmc-13279890.description: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used clinically and in research, including AI-driven applications for cognitive state analysis and neurological disorder detection, such as epilepsy. However, automated seizure detection faces challenges, including inconsistent windowing, timestamp misalignment, label-based signal segmentation, and unstructured large-scale EEG data—especially critical in event-driven settings.

pmc-13331237.title: Consensus on the definition of locoregional recurrence of colon cancer: protocol for an international Delphi study
pmc-13331237.creator: Eva Rademaker, Anne E Petersen, Eva Angenete, Alvaro Arjona-Sánchez, Stefan Benz, Claus A Bertelsen, Johanne G Bloemen, Wim Ceelen, Esther C J Consten, Deena Harji, Ignace H J T de Hingh, Olivier Glehen, Ben Griffiths, Helene Perregaard, Jeanine M L Roodhart, Martin Rutegård, Henk M W Verheul, Johan
pmc-13331237.description: AbstractIntroductionCancer recurrence is a pivotal outcome after treatment with curative intent for colon cancer patients, as it is related to worse survival, the subsequent need for further treatment and the associated use of healthcare resources. However, at present there is no consensus regarding the definition of locoregional recurrence of colon cancer.

pmc-13536061.title: Delivery strategies for malaria chemoprevention in the post-discharge management of children hospitalised with severe anaemia or severe malaria: protocol for a cluster randomised controlled implementation trial in Benin
pmc-13536061.creator: Manfred Accrombessi, Landry Assongba, Carole Khairallah, Tao Chen, Benjamine Tchéhoundjè, Edouard Dangbénon, Daleb Abdoulaye, Jeanne Perpétue Vincent, Juliet Otieno Awori, Adrian J F Luty, Jenna Hoyt, Amanda McCoy, Eve Worrall, Valérie Briand, Feiko O ter Kuile, Achille Massougbodji, Jenny Hill
pmc-13536061.description: IntroductionChildren discharged after in-hospital treatment for severe anaemia or severe malaria in sub-Saharan Africa remain at high risk of readmission and death, particularly in malaria-endemic settings where recurrent infections are common. Post-discharge malaria chemoprevention (PDMC) has demonstrated substantial reductions in mortality and hospital readmissions and is now recommended by the WHO.
